description: Loss of containment from a component or system (internal or external).
Required output is absent.
Output below required specification.
Output above required specification.
Output is unstable, intermittent, oscillating or fluctuating.
Component does not move as intended due to seizure/jamming.
Flow or movement impeded by obstruction or fouling.
Presence of crack or breakage in a component.
Permanent shape change such as bending, buckling or yielding.
Material removal/deterioration causing loss of function (e.g., wear, scoring, fretting).
Material degradation due to corrosion.
Material removal due to erosion.
Excess temperature causing malfunction or damage.
Unintended conductive path resulting in short circuit.
Break in electrical continuity.
Undesired connection to ground or loss of electrical isolation.
Expected signal/indication/alarm not received.
Signal/indication/alarm is wrong relative to actual condition.
Parameter has drifted out of tolerance.
Unintended trip or shutdown due to fault or error.
Faulty or no function due to software issue.
Observable external damage such as dent or broken enclosure.
Foreign matter present in or on the item.
Loss of mechanical or electrical connection.
Abnormal vibration exceeding acceptable limits.
Damage or malfunction due to vapor bubble formation/collapse.
Catastrophic loss of containment due to burst or rupture.
Failure mode not otherwise classified.
Failure mode cannot be determined.
